EterminAPIKeyCredential.title: Etermin API Keys
EterminAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: Copy the public API key and private secret key from your eTermin account settings under Configuration → Integration – API → API. NoClick signs each request with a fresh salt and HMAC-SHA256. Both keys are required. Connecting reads your account's calendars.
